issue.detail: Spec says synchronous reset sets output to zero; contract says update_during_reset true and visible same_cycle. Alternative semantics: reset is synchronous but output updates only on next posedge after reset asserted (i.e., reset sampled at edge). Distinguishing sequence: first row reset=1,d=0 then second row reset=0,d=5; if reset is same-cycle visible, q after first edge is 0; if reset requires prior edge, q after first edge may be unspecified/old.
issue.spec_evidence: active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero
issue.alternative: Reset is sampled at posedge but output zeroing occurs on the following posedge (one-cycle delayed reset visibility).

issue.detail: Contract states initial q before first posedge is unspecified; spec does not specify initial value. Alternative: initial q is zero. Distinguishing sequence: first row reset=0,d=7; if initial zero and capture, q=7 after edge; if unspecified, any value possible before edge but after edge q=7 regardless, so not distinguishing. Better: first row reset=1,d=7; if initial zero, q=0 after edge; if unspecified, q=0 after reset edge anyway. No distinguishing sequence for initial value given synchronous reset/capture on first edge.
